html:
If you’re living with debilitating knee pain, you’ve likely heard mixed reports on surgery. Some tell you it’s only for older people. Others say the recovery is lengthy and painful. At Silver Touch Hospitals, we hear all about these issues daily, and we also know how frequently they deter individuals from receiving the care they really deserve.

As a hospital chain providing sophisticated orthopaedic treatment, including knee replacement in Ahmedabad, we would like to put the record straight. The following are the most prevalent myths we hear, and the facts that dispel them.

Myth 1: Knee replacement is only for people over 60

Myth. Although it’s more prevalent in the older population, we also commonly treat younger patients, particularly those with early osteoarthritis, sports-related injuries, or genetic joint diseases, who can greatly improve their condition with the procedure. If knee pain is interfering with your work, walking, or sleep, age is not the determining factor. The most important factor is the quality of life, not your birthdate.

Myth 2: Recovery takes forever

Recovery timelines vary, but most patients start walking with support within a day or two after surgery. With proper physiotherapy, many return to daily routines in six to eight weeks. Some even resume low-impact sports in a few months. At Silver Touch Hospitals, we customise rehabilitation plans based on your goals, not just general averages.

Myth 3: The implant won’t last long

With newer technology and surgical expertise, implants today can last 15 to 20 years or longer. We use sophisticated joint replacement methods and contemporary implant designs that enhance durability as well as mobility. For many patients, one surgery provides enduring relief.

Myth 4: It’s safer to just keep taking painkillers

Medications may relieve pain temporarily, but they do not cure the issue. Chronic use of drugs, particularly NSAIDs, can cause long-term hazards such as stomach ulcers, liver stress, or kidney injury. If conservative measures fail, surgery is the more lasting and superior solution.

Myth 5: All hospitals provide the same outcomes

This is important. Not every facility is equally experienced with surgery, infection control, or rehabilitation assistance. At Silver Touch Hospitals, our orthopaedic care units are designed with superior surgical equipment, infection-free operation theatres, and a panel of dedicated orthopaedic surgeons specialising in knee replacement in Ahmedabad. Our performance is self-explanatory.

Know the Facts, Make the Right Choice

Total knee replacement is not a last option – it’s a successful, life-altering solution for individuals with chronic pain and compromised mobility. The solution lies in reliable information and quality care.

If you or the person you love is contemplating surgery, don’t let misinformation get in the way. At Silver Touch Hospitals, we’re here to walk you through every step, from diagnosis to rehabilitation, with straight talk and practical solutions.
